name: AK16AAH - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared & Electrochemical Sensors, App Connected
highlights: The AK16AA, Sensing Raised a Tier — Bluetooth logging stays exactly as it is; the sensing underneath changes. Infrared NDIR CO₂ and an electrochemical formaldehyde cell replace the semiconductor elements — the highest AK16 specification short of adding carbon monoxide.
Report-Grade Numbers, Exportable — A defensible reading is useful; a defensible reading with a time series behind it closes the argument. This device produces both.
Eight Parameters, Full Particulate Split — Nothing is dropped to make room for the connectivity.
2000 mAh, Six Hours — Three-hour USB-C charge, 249 g.
Add CO Where There Is a Flame — AK16DAH-CO is this device with an electrochemical carbon monoxide cell — the configuration for kitchens, garages and boiler rooms.
